global_pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the ProxSMTP daemon.

global_log_file.description: Path to the main log file. Leave empty to log to stdout/stderr.

global_log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

global_listen_addr.description: IP address the proxy listens on. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

global_listen_port.description: Port the proxy listens on for incoming SMTP (typically 25, 587, or 465).

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for inbound connections (STARTTLS or implicit TLS depending on port).

tls_cert_path.description: Path to the server TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_path.description: Path to the server TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_ca_file.description: Optional path to CA bundle for client certificate verification.

backend_servers.description: List of backend SMTP servers to which proxsmtp will relay messages.

name.description: Unique identifier for the backend server.

address.description: IP address or hostname of the backend server.

port.description: Port on the backend server (usually 25, 587, or 465).

tls.description: Use TLS when connecting to this backend (STARTTLS or implicit).

timeout.description: Connection and operation timeout in seconds.

acl_rules.description: Access control rules to filter or modify messages based on sender/recipient/etc.

match_sender.description: List of sender patterns (domains or email addresses) to match.

match_recipient.description: Optional list of recipient patterns to match.

match_header.description: Optional list of header patterns (e.g., 'Subject:.*SPAM' or 'X-Spam: yes').

rewrite_to.description: Target address to rewrite matched recipients to (used only if action=rewrite).

reject_message.description: SMTP rejection message to return to client (used only if action=reject).

relay_domains.description: List of domains or subnets for which the proxy will accept and relay mail.

name.description: Descriptive name for the relay entry.

domain.description: Domain name (e.g., 'example.com') allowed for relay. Use only if not using network.

network.description: CIDR subnet (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') allowed for relay. Use only if not using domain.

auth_required.description: Require authentication (SASL) before relaying mail from this domain/network.

auth_backend.description: Optional authentication backend for SASL. If omitted, only IP-based relay is supported.

uri.description: LDAP server URI (required for ldap type).

base_dn.description: Base DN for user searches (required for ldap type).

bind_dn.description: Bind DN for querying the LDAP server (required for ldap type).

bind_password.description: Password for bind DN (required for ldap type).

connection_string.description: Database connection string (e.g., 'sqlite://...', 'mysql://...') (required for sql type).

user_query.default: SELECT password FROM users WHERE email = ?
user_query.description: SQL query to retrieve password for a given email address (required for sql type).
